title: Noam Chomsky - Why Does the U.S. Support Israel?
summary: A short clip of Noam Chomsky explaining why the United States supports Israel, framing it in terms of strategic interests and foreign policy. It is posted by a channel that collects his talks.
why: Used as a source for the argument that US support for Israel is systematic and strategic, and for Chomsky's view of Palestine as resistance to colonialism.

quote.text: Noan Chomsky says the issue of Palestine is resistance against colonialism.
